Titans registers Runtime as a dependency and resolves it through Scarlet GetModules() at Start.
Runtime server exposes RegisterReactionValidator.

Detection uses Runtime.Gear facade.

Reeling + goal prediction branch exists.
Curved and gear prediction exists.
Detection distinguishes linear, reeling-goal and orbit prediction modes.
Prediction calls use a batch window.
Frame cache exists.
Prediction cache survives EndBatch and is cleared by the next movement sample.
Debug detection box visualization exists.
Nape/Eyes/Mouth require their named point and cannot fall back to Head.
Limb hitbox uses .Touched.
Limb hitbox is welded to animated limb.
CanTouch is enabled/leased for active hitbox.
Touched events are restricted to known local-character body parts.
Delayed activation exists.
Priority limb override exists.
Limb hitbox keeps Requiem Touched detection; overlap is only a start-overlap fallback.
Hitbox listener cleanup is visible.
Hitbox runner disconnects only the RenderStepped connection it still owns.
Wire resistance, excess resistance and effect branch exists.
Normal Requiem grab does not require createKinematicInfluence; animated limb + physical hitbox is the source contract.
Grab action creates limb hitbox.
Grab resources are bound to cleanup.
Client grab state and gear cleanup exist.
Server grab lifecycle cleanup exists.
Grab ownership is target-centric and cleans on PlayerRemoving.
Action response boundary exists.
Action response is epoch-bound.
Target ownership validation exists.
Action response is bound to the committed target user.
Physical response rejects unmatched limb fallback.
Server physical validation resolves canonical rig points to BaseParts through RigMap.
Response epoch is consumed only after handler acceptance.
Scarlet visual preparation policy exists.
Animated visual remains queryable for wire raycasts.
Root transform clamp policy exists and must be action-gated.
Generic IK influence exists.
IK easing lifecycle exists.
Motor/origin cleanup exists.
IK chain guards exist.
Prediction runner has Requiem-style angular/curve analysis and fixed-step integration.
LookAt uses Requiem SmoothTime defaults.
Bite IK uses Requiem easing defaults.
Core reaction cooldown exists.
Core cooldown is independent from animation cleanup.
Core/reaction classification exists.
Animation length/speed contract exists.
GrappleJumpShake binds Up/Down keyframes through the returned AnimationTrack.
Wire-swat has a raycast path.
Wire-swat sounds are mapped.
Wire-swat fade/volume/playback timing matches Requiem through Scarlet Effects.
Mouth hitbox fires the response before optional record cleanup and remains lifecycle-bound.
Eaten player reaction animation is present in the shared animation contract.
Wire-swat monologue branch exists.
LongRangeAttackGround crush uses a 5-second default ragdoll.
GrappleJumpShake landing uses a 5-second ragdoll.
Cooldown uses shared clock contract.
Titan registry cleanup hook exists.
Only the authoritative target client runs the local Titan action chooser.
Scheduler has prediction/step batch contract.
Client Titan lifecycle has kinematic cleanup path.
Normal/Default Titans are exclusively owned by the Requiem runtime when enabled.
All 30 Requiem Default action paths are present.
